source_title: Bhakra flood gates to be opened today (The Tribune, 10 Aug 2015)
quote: Today, the water level at the dam was 1661.10 ft at 2 pm; 14,500 cusecs being released in the Sutlej by the BBMB ... water up to 50,000 cusec will be released downstream of the Nangal Dam at 11 am tomorrow

source_title: Bhakra Dam authorities open floodgates after 2 years, 45,000 cusecs released (PTI via Newsdrum, 19 Aug 2025)
quote: Bhakra's floodgates were last opened on August 13, 2023, when water levels touched 1672 ft, close to the dam's maximum capacity of 1680.82 ft.

source_title: Breaking: All four floodgates of Bhakra dam opened (Babushahi, 19 Aug 2025)
quote: With the water level of Bhakra Dam crossing the danger mark of 1665 feet ... the dam's water level to 1665.06 feet. On Tuesday alone, an inflow of 65,617 cusecs was recorded. A total of 43,300 cusecs of water, including turbine discharge, has been released
